description: Scrape sale and rental property listings from ChavesNaMão with city, price, room, area, type and sorting filters, or fetch full details for known listings.

areaMax.description: Maximum usable area in square metres. Leave empty for no maximum.
areaMax.title: Maximum area (m²)

areaMin.description: Minimum usable area in square metres. Leave empty for no minimum.
areaMin.title: Minimum area (m²)

bathroomsMin.description: Minimum number of bathrooms (banheiros). Use 0 for no minimum.
bathroomsMin.title: Minimum bathrooms

bedroomsMin.description: Minimum number of bedrooms (quartos). Use 0 for no minimum.
bedroomsMin.title: Minimum bedrooms

city.description: Brazilian city to search in listings mode. For any other city, paste one of its ChavesNaMão search URLs into Listing URLs.
city.title: City

collectionMode.description: Search listings by city and filters, or fetch full details for specific ChavesNaMão listings.
collectionMode.title: What to collect

garagesMin.description: Minimum number of garage or parking spaces (vagas). Use 0 for no minimum.
garagesMin.title: Minimum parking spaces

includeDetails.description: Fetch each listing's detail page data: full description, publisher phone and CRECI, photo list, amenities, video and tour links, created and updated dates. Costs one extra request per listing.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full details

listingUrls.description: Optional ChavesNaMão search URLs to scrape exactly as configured on the site. Use this for cities, neighbourhoods or filter combinations not covered by the controls above.
listingUrls.title: Listing URLs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listings to save across all selected searches (1–1000).
maxItems.title: Maximum listings

maxPages.description: Maximum result pages to request for each search (30 listings per page). Stops earlier when the source runs out.
maxPages.title: Maximum pages per search

ownerType.description: Show every advertiser, only listings direct from the owner, or only real-estate agencies.
ownerType.title: Advertiser

priceMax.description: Maximum asking price in Brazilian reais. Leave empty for no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum price (BRL)

priceMin.description: Minimum asking price in Brazilian reais. Leave empty for no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum price (BRL)

propertyIds.description: ChavesNaMão listing IDs to fetch in details mode. Property URLs also work.
propertyIds.title: Property IDs

propertyType.description: Restrict the search to one property type, or search every type.
propertyType.sectionDescription: These filters apply when mode is Search listings. Any value left at zero or empty is not sent to ChavesNaMão.
propertyType.title: Property type

propertyUrls.description: ChavesNaMão property URLs to fetch in details mode (they contain an id-<number> segment).
propertyUrls.title: Property detail URLs

transactionType.description: Whether to search properties for sale (venda) or for rent (aluguel).
transactionType.title: Sale or rent

title: ChavesNaMão City Property Listings Extractor
